hints.text: This is an &lit clue, which means the whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay. So, here, our answer will be a word that matches our clue’s description of ‘Slender shiny sharpened steel strikers’.

The wordplay in this clue isn’t particularly traditional - we’re not looking for an anagram or a deletion, for example. But, setting aside specific techniques, much of solving cryptics is about pattern recognition, and there is a pattern here. If we find what these words have in common, we might find our answer.
